'''Camp Two''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camp set up by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. After conquering [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the Federation built three camps on separate islands near the base of a waterfall on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] to hold captured civilians. A [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield gate]] was also constructed on the opposite side of the islands from the waterfall. Camp Two was situated on an island that was between the other two. During the [[Raid on the Solleu River]], the prisoners were liberated by [[Rescue 2]] of [[Rescue Flight]]. Camp 2 apparently had the most prisoners of the three camps since Rescue 2 was the only Rescue Boat to report being overloaded. Rescue 2 was able to deliver the prisoners to the ''[[Mercatan]]'', which transported the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] to a place free from the Trade Federation.
